title: Cyclotomicity of the S-matrix of a complex modular category
difficulty_reason: Given the actual earlier fusion-character and S-orthogonality inputs, the author extracts a Galois permutation of rows, transfers the character norm to duality and normalized dimension, then turns the corrected normalized entries into a signed row and column action. Choosing opposite index actions for two automorphisms proves their commutation on the generating entries of a finite normal field. Kronecker–Weber applies after this new abelianness argument.

source_roles.source_scope: Original modular fusion category over k=C, all entries of the S matrix, existence of a common root of unity ξ with entries in Q(ξ). No assumption of unitarity, pseudounitarity or known categorical dimension positivity.
source_roles.source_label_caveats: Keep the original invocation of 8.14.5 as printed. That corollary has a false fixed-output matrix formula; the actual original Corollary 3.7.7 and the distinct characters of 8.14.2 give the exhaustion premise directly in the stated complex scope. Of (8.55), use only the correct initial equality from 8.14.2 as explicitly expanded in the Galois argument. The normalization correction of the errata governs the adjacent sign display even though the original display leaves the two dimensions unbarred. See SOURCE_DIAGNOSTICS.json for the exact observations.
